input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds AP anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for compete/competing/competitor, exclusivity, first-look, field-of-use, territory, minimum volume and "Customer shall not / will not" language returned nothing restricting the businesses AP may operate or the products or services it may buy or build. To the contrary, Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms AP may offer Inventory via other agents or sell Inventory to third parties. The only Customer-side prohibitions (p0025) are ordinary licence-scope terms for Kubient's own Service (no third-party access, no reverse engineering, no resale or service-bureau use of the Service); they do not restrict AP's own business, products or procurement of competing ad-tech, so they are not a non-compete or field-of-use restriction under this rule. The clause therefore meets the preferred position: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction. No redline proposed.
